verses.original: Γίνεσθε μιμηταὶ τοῦ Θεοῦ οὖν ὡς ἀγαπητά τέκνα
verses.transliteration: Ginesthe mimētai tou Theou oun hōs agapēta tekna
verses.literal: Be imitators - of God therefore as beloved children

verses.original: καὶ περιπατεῖτε ἐν ἀγάπῃ καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς καὶ παρέδωκεν ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας καὶ θυσίαν προσφορὰν τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: kai peripateite en agapē kathōs kai ho Christos ēgapēsen hēmas kai paredōken heauton hyper hēmōn eis osmēn euōdias kai thysian prosphoran tō Theō
verses.literal: and walk in love just as . . . - Christ loved us and gave Himself up . . . for us as vvv a fragrant - sacrificial offering - to God

verses.original: δὲ ἐν ὑμῖν καθὼς πρέπει ἁγίοις μηδὲ ὀνομαζέσθω Πορνεία καὶ πᾶσα ἀκαθαρσία ἢ πλεονεξία
verses.transliteration: de en hymin kathōs prepei hagiois mēde onomazesthō Porneia kai pasa akatharsia ē pleonexia
verses.literal: But among you as is proper among the saints vvv there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality [or] of any kind of impurity or of greed

verses.original: καὶ αἰσχρότης καὶ μωρολογία ἢ εὐτραπελία ἃ οὐκ ἀνῆκεν ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον εὐχαριστία
verses.transliteration: kai aischrotēs kai mōrologia ē eutrapelia ha ouk anēken alla mallon eucharistia
verses.literal: [Nor should there be] obscenity - foolish talk or crude joking which vvv are out of character but rather thanksgiving

verses.original: γὰρ τοῦτο ἴστε γινώσκοντες ὅτι πᾶς πόρνος ἢ ἀκάθαρτος ἢ πλεονέκτης ὅ ἐστιν εἰδωλολάτρης ἔχει οὐκ κληρονομίαν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar touto iste ginōskontes hoti pas pornos ē akathartos ē pleonektēs ho estin eidōlolatrēs echei ouk klēronomian en tē basileia tou Christou kai Theou
verses.literal: For of this vvv you can be sure - [No] immoral - impure or greedy person (that is an idolater) has [any] inheritance in the kingdom - of Christ and of God

verses.original: Μηδεὶς ἀπατάτω ὑμᾶς κενοῖς λόγοις γὰρ διὰ ταῦτα τοῦ ἡ ὀργὴ Θεοῦ ἔρχεται ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῆς ἀπειθείας
verses.transliteration: Mēdeis apatatō hymas kenois logois gar dia tauta tou hē orgē Theou erchetai epi tous huious tēs apeitheias
verses.literal: {Let} no one deceive you with empty words for because of such things - the wrath of God is coming on the sons - of disobedience

verses.original: οὖν μὴ γίνεσθε συμμέτοχοι αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: oun mē ginesthe symmetochoi autōn
verses.literal: Therefore {do} not be partakers with them

verses.original: γάρ Ἦτε ποτε σκότος δὲ νῦν φῶς ἐν Κυρίῳ περιπατεῖτε ὡς τέκνα φωτὸς
verses.transliteration: gar Ēte pote skotos de nyn phōs en Kyriō peripateite hōs tekna phōtos
verses.literal: For you were once darkness but now [you are] light in [the] Lord Walk as children of light

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ καρπὸς τοῦ φωτὸς ἐν πάσῃ ἀγαθωσύνῃ καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἀληθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: gar ho karpos tou phōtos en pasē agathōsynē kai dikaiosynē kai alētheia
verses.literal: for the fruit of the light [consists] in all goodness - righteousness and truth

verses.original: δοκιμάζοντες τί ἐστιν εὐάρεστον τῷ Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: dokimazontes ti estin euareston tō Kyriō
verses.literal: Test and prove what vvv pleases the Lord

verses.original: Καὶ μὴ συνκοινωνεῖτε τοῖς τοῖς ἀκάρποις ἔργοις τοῦ σκότους δὲ καὶ μᾶλλον ἐλέγχετε
verses.transliteration: Kai mē synkoinōneite tois tois akarpois ergois tou skotous de kai mallon elenchete
verses.literal: - vvv Have no fellowship with the - fruitless deeds - of darkness but . . . rather expose [them]

verses.original: γὰρ ἐστιν αἰσχρόν καὶ λέγειν τὰ γινόμενα ὑπ’ αὐτῶν κρυφῇ
verses.transliteration: gar estin aischron kai legein ta ginomena hyp’ autōn kryphē
verses.literal: For it is shameful even to mention what [the disobedient] do . . . . . . in secret

verses.original: τὰ δὲ πάντα ἐλεγχόμενα ὑπὸ τοῦ φωτὸς φανεροῦται γὰρ πᾶν τὸ φανερούμενον ἐστιν φῶς
verses.transliteration: ta de panta elenchomena hypo tou phōtos phaneroutai gar pan to phaneroumenon estin phōs
verses.literal: - But everything exposed by the light becomes visible for everything that is illuminated becomes a light [itself]

verses.original: διὸ λέγει Ἔγειρε ὁ καθεύδων καὶ ἀνάστα ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν καὶ ὁ Χριστός ἐπιφαύσει σοι
verses.transliteration: dio legei Egeire ho katheudōn kai anasta ek tōn nekrōn kai ho Christos epiphausei soi
verses.literal: So it is said Wake up O sleeper - rise up from the dead and - Christ will shine on you

verses.original: ἀκριβῶς Βλέπετε οὖν πῶς περιπατεῖτε μὴ ὡς ἄσοφοι ἀλλ’ ὡς σοφοί
verses.transliteration: akribōs Blepete oun pōs peripateite mē hōs asophoi all’ hōs sophoi
verses.literal: Pay careful attention then to how you walk not as unwise but as wise

verses.original: ἐξαγοραζόμενοι τὸν καιρόν ὅτι αἱ ἡμέραι εἰσιν πονηραί
verses.transliteration: exagorazomenoi ton kairon hoti hai hēmerai eisin ponērai
verses.literal: redeeming the time because the days are evil

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο μὴ γίνεσθε ἄφρονες ἀλλὰ συνίετε τί τὸ τοῦ Κυρίου θέλημα
verses.transliteration: dia touto mē ginesthe aphrones alla syniete ti to tou Kyriou thelēma
verses.literal: Therefore . . . {do} not be foolish but understand what the - Lord’s will [is]

verses.original: καὶ μὴ μεθύσκεσθε οἴνῳ ἐν ᾧ ἐστιν ἀσωτία ἀλλὰ πληροῦσθε ἐν Πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: kai mē methyskesthe oinō en hō estin asōtia alla plērousthe en Pneumati
verses.literal: - {Do} not get drunk on wine - which leads to reckless indiscretion Instead be filled with [the] Spirit

verses.original: λαλοῦντες ἑαυτοῖς ἐν ψαλμοῖς καὶ ὕμνοις καὶ πνευματικαῖς ᾠδαῖς ᾄδοντες καὶ ψάλλοντες τῇ ὑμῶν καρδίᾳ τῷ Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: lalountes heautois en psalmois kai hymnois kai pneumatikais ōdais adontes kai psallontes tē hymōn kardia tō Kyriō
verses.literal: Speak to one another with psalms - hymns and spiritual songs Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord

verses.original: πάντοτε εὐχαριστοῦντες τῷ Θεῷ καὶ Πατρί ὑπὲρ πάντων ἐν ὀνόματι ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: pantote eucharistountes tō Theō kai Patri hyper pantōn en onomati hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: always giving thanks to God - [the] Father for everything in [the] name of our - Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: Ὑποτασσόμενοι ἀλλήλοις ἐν φόβῳ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hypotassomenoi allēlois en phobō Christou
verses.literal: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ

verses.original: Αἱ γυναῖκες τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν ὡς τῷ Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Hai gynaikes tois idiois andrasin hōs tō Kyriō
verses.literal: - Wives [submit] to your husbands as to the Lord

verses.original: ὅτι ἀνήρ ἐστιν κεφαλὴ τῆς γυναικὸς καὶ ὡς ὁ Χριστὸς κεφαλὴ τῆς ἐκκλησίας τοῦ σώματος αὐτὸς σωτὴρ
verses.transliteration: hoti anēr estin kephalē tēs gynaikos kai hōs ho Christos kephalē tēs ekklēsias tou sōmatos autos sōtēr
verses.literal: For [the] husband is [the] head of the wife - as - Christ [is the] head of the church [His] body [of which] He [is the] Savior

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ὡς ἡ ἐκκλησία ὑποτάσσεται τῷ Χριστῷ οὕτως καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες τοῖς ἀνδράσιν ἐν παντί
verses.transliteration: alla hōs hē ekklēsia hypotassetai tō Christō houtōs kai hai gynaikes tois andrasin en panti
verses.literal: Now as the church submits - to Christ so also - wives [should submit] to their husbands in everything

verses.original: Οἱ ἄνδρες ἀγαπᾶτε τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ καθὼς ὁ Χριστὸς ἠγάπησεν τὴν ἐκκλησίαν καὶ παρέδωκεν ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Hoi andres agapate tas gynaikas kai kathōs ho Christos ēgapēsen tēn ekklēsian kai paredōken heauton hyper autēs
verses.literal: - Husbands love [your] wives just as - Christ loved the church and gave Himself up . . . for her

verses.original: ἵνα ἁγιάσῃ αὐτὴν καθαρίσας τῷ λουτρῷ τοῦ ὕδατος ἐν ῥήματι
verses.transliteration: hina hagiasē autēn katharisas tō loutrō tou hydatos en rhēmati
verses.literal: to sanctify her cleansing [her] by the washing - with water through [the] word

verses.original: ἵνα παραστήσῃ αὐτὸς ἑαυτῷ ἔνδοξον τὴν ἐκκλησίαν μὴ ἔχουσαν σπίλον ἢ ῥυτίδα ἤ τι τῶν τοιούτων ἀλλ’ ἵνα ᾖ ἁγία καὶ ἄμωμος
verses.transliteration: hina parastēsē autos heautō endoxon tēn ekklēsian mē echousan spilon ē rhytida ē ti tōn toioutōn all’ hina ē hagia kai amōmos
verses.literal: [and] to present her to Himself as a glorious - church vvv without stain or wrinkle or any - such [blemish] but - - holy and blameless

verses.original: Οὕτως καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες ὀφείλουσιν ἀγαπᾶν τὰς ἑαυτῶν γυναῖκας ὡς τὰ ἑαυτῶν σώματα ὁ ἀγαπῶν ἑαυτοῦ τὴν γυναῖκα ἀγαπᾷ ἑαυτὸν
verses.transliteration: Houtōs kai hoi andres opheilousin agapan tas heautōn gynaikas hōs ta heautōn sōmata ho agapōn heautou tēn gynaika agapa heauton
verses.literal: In the same way . . . - husbands ought to love - their wives as - their own bodies He who loves his - wife loves himself

verses.original: γάρ οὐδεὶς ποτε ἐμίσησεν ἑαυτοῦ τὴν σάρκα ἀλλὰ ἐκτρέφει καὶ θάλπει αὐτήν καθὼς ὁ Χριστὸς καὶ τὴν ἐκκλησίαν
verses.transliteration: gar oudeis pote emisēsen heautou tēn sarka alla ektrephei kai thalpei autēn kathōs ho Christos kai tēn ekklēsian
verses.literal: Indeed no one ever hated his [own] body but he nourishes and cherishes it just as - Christ [does] the church

verses.original: ὅτι ἐσμὲν μέλη τοῦ αὐτοῦ σώματος
verses.transliteration: hoti esmen melē tou autou sōmatos
verses.literal: For we are members of His body

verses.original: Ἀντὶ τούτου ἄνθρωπος καταλείψει τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ προσκολληθήσεται πρὸς αὐτοῦ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ οἱ δύο ἔσονται εἰς μίαν σάρκα
verses.transliteration: Anti toutou anthrōpos kataleipsei ton patera kai tēn mētera kai proskollēthēsetai pros autou tēn gynaika kai hoi dyo esontai eis mian sarka
verses.literal: For this reason . . . a man will leave his father and - mother and be united to his - wife and the two will become . . . one flesh

verses.original: τοῦτο τὸ μυστήριον ἐστίν μέγα δὲ ἐγὼ λέγω εἰς Χριστὸν καὶ εἰς τὴν ἐκκλησίαν
verses.transliteration: touto to mystērion estin mega de egō legō eis Christon kai eis tēn ekklēsian
verses.literal: This - mystery is profound but I am speaking about Christ and - the church

verses.original: πλὴν οἱ ἕκαστος καθ’ ἕνα ὑμεῖς καὶ οὕτως ἀγαπάτω ἑαυτοῦ τὴν γυναῖκα ὡς ἑαυτόν δὲ ἡ γυνὴ ἵνα φοβῆται τὸν ἄνδρα
verses.transliteration: plēn hoi hekastos kath’ hena hymeis kai houtōs agapatō heautou tēn gynaika hōs heauton de hē gynē hina phobētai ton andra
verses.literal: Nevertheless - each one . . . . . . of you also . . . must love his - wife as [he loves] himself and the wife - must respect [her] husband
